column3: NASB renders “was remembered” as “have been remembered.”
NASB follows the critical text without “who, when he comes, will speak to you”; it adds “to come to you.”
NASB follows the critical text; “you did well having come” is rendered “you have been kind enough to come.”
NASB renders “Of a truth I grasped” as “I most certainly understand now.”
NASB adds “the man”; “working righteousness” is rendered “does what is right,” and “acceptable” is “welcome.”
NASB puts “He is Lord of all” in parentheses; “evangelizing peace” is rendered “preaching peace.”
NASB follows the critical text; “declaration” is rendered “thing.”
NASB follows the critical text; “tree” is rendered “cross.”
NASB follows the critical text; “revealed” is rendered “visible.”
NASB adds “that is” and renders “rising” as “He arose.”
NASB follows the critical text; “proclaim” is rendered “preach.”
“Declarations” is rendered “words,” and “the word” is “the message.”
NASB renders “the believers from the circumcision” as “the circumcised believers.”
NASB follows the critical text; “magnifying” is rendered “exalting.”
NASB follows the critical text; it recasts the question with “can he?”
NASB follows the critical text (“Jesus Christ”).
